section_summary.extract_value: This section summarizes the findings of the present paper, which identified significant correlations between perceived social support, psychological capital, and loneliness among adolescents. Specifically, perceived social support was negatively correlated with loneliness and positively correlated with psychological capital, while psychological capital was negatively correlated with loneliness. The paper also found that psychological capital partially mediates the relationship between perceived social support and loneliness, offering a theoretical basis for interventions to alleviate adolescent loneliness and promote healthy development.
